sections.line: The title and the attribution of the Nine of Disks, pdf p181, p236.

quotes.quote: The Nine of Disks is called Gain.
The card is ruled by Venus in Virgo.

sections.title: Crowley's description of the card
sections.line: Crowley's description of the Nine of Disks, pdf p236.

quotes.quote: It shows good luck attending material affairs, favour and popularity.
